notes.title: Terrarium Land patch v.2.01
notes.content:
- fixed localization
- fixed: some interface errors and its management
- fixed:  method of achievements obtaining  from scanning
- added: new beetle kind of enemy on the beginning levels
- added: ability to disable some upgrades
- improved: game interface using gamepad
- improved: camera of the character
- improved: graphics and sound of the base bomb
- improved:  mechanics of the terrarium elements discovery
- improved: big caterpillar
- small changes on first levels

and other small changes

notes.title: Terrarium Land v.1.05 patch
notes.content:
[b]Fixed bugs:	[/b]
-Fixed errors when skipping cinematics.
-Pop up figures -  don't crawl on the menu interface now.
-Gamepad,-  the image menu button at the hints was changed.
-Statistics of the goods purchase was fixed.
-Last level transition to the final cinematics was corrected.

[b]Changed:	[/b]
-Sound for opening the statistics window was added.
-When value  is zero the number of ammo will be displayed.
-Changing of the SFX volume  will work at all objects.

[b]Graphics changes:[/b]
-Visual effect of the sleeping was changed.
-Depth of field (DOF) and fog on some levels was corrected.
-Models of the wires  are added on some levels.
-Some collisions meshes was corrected.

And other improvements.

notes.title: Terrarium Land patch added.
notes.content:
[b]Patch changes: [/b]

 [b]  Different difficulty will influences at:	[/b]
Waiting time of the transport 
Count of the stars drop down.

[b] Only at easy difficulty:[/b]
Half count of stars drop down if neutral died not from us.
From teleporting objects will be drop down stars.

[b]  Shop:[/b]
Waiting time of the transport displayed now.

[b] Levels:[/b]
Butterflies will be spawned after hero death. 
"Use icon" added at teleport on "Abandoned beach" level.
"Use icon" added at butterfly on "Coral island" level.
